asset_assignment.empty_message: Assign existing units or property assets to this space.

form.name_info: The space name as it appears in listings, rent invoices, and rental-plan breakdowns.
form.description_info: Optional detail shown on space detail pages and tenant-facing documents.
form.line_info: Group spaces into categories such as offices, warehouses, buildings, or land.
form.active_info: Inactive spaces are hidden from new rental plans and transactions.
form.variant_mode_info: Turn on when this space has distinct unit configurations with separate pricing.
form.variant_mode_locked_help: Delete all unit types and options first to change this setting.
form.variant_mode_locked_error: Delete all unit types and options before changing the unit-type mode.

delivery_mode_value_info.instant: Provided in a single transaction, such as handing over an access device.
delivery_mode_value_info.scheduled: Provided at an agreed time, such as a booked inspection or maintenance visit.
delivery_mode_value_info.shipped: Physical goods delivered to the tenant or property.
delivery_mode_value_info.digital: Digital access or materials provided electronically.
delivery_mode_value_info.project: Work delivered through stages, such as a tenant fit-out.
delivery_mode_value_info.subscription: Ongoing occupancy or access over a rental or lease term.

form.tracking_mode_info: Controls stock counting for goods and supplies. This setting does not assign a specific property to a tenant.

tracking_mode_value_info.none: No stock counting. Suitable for occupancy rights and services; does not track physical property allocation.
tracking_mode_value_info.bulk: Count interchangeable goods or supplies by quantity.
tracking_mode_value_info.serialized: Track each stock item individually, such as numbered equipment or access devices.

form.tax_treatment_info: How rent for this space is classified for tax purposes.
form.withholding_class_info: The withholding tax class that applies when the tenant is a withholding agent.
form.name: Space Name
form.product_kind_info: Classify what this offering provides: occupancy or a service, goods sold, or supplies used in property operations.
form.delivery_mode_info: Choose how the tenant receives the offering. Occupancy over a term represents ongoing access under a rental or lease arrangement.

product_kind_value_info.service: Occupancy rights or a service provided to the tenant; the property itself is not sold as stock.
product_kind_value_info.stocked_good: Physical goods held in stock and sold to tenants, such as replacement access devices.
product_kind_value_info.non_stocked_good: Physical goods sold to tenants without holding stock, such as special-order fixtures.
product_kind_value_info.consumable: Supplies used in property operations, such as cleaning materials or maintenance supplies.

validation.price_required_for_simple: Price is required when this space has no unit variants.
